title: Omix Project
description: Root project definition for an Omix Builder project. A project is the top-level container that defines all pages, components, flows, and design tokens for an application. Example: { id: 'proj_abc123', name: 'My App', version: '1.0.0', pages: [...], components: [...] }

name.description: Human-readable project name. Example: E-Commerce Dashboard

version.description: Semantic version of the project. Example: 1.0.0 or 2.1.0-beta

pages.description: Array of pages/screens in the project.

components.description: Reusable components defined at the project level.

flows.description: User flows and workflows within the project.

designTokens.description: Global design token system for the project.

basePath.description: Base URL path for the application. Example: /app

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of project creation. Example: 2024-01-15T10:30:00Z

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last project update.
